strategy.offer: Mobile and stationary machinery, plants, parts, consulting, training, repairs, and maintenance for processing, separating, mixing, conveying, and upgrading waste and other material streams.
strategy.customers: Recycling, waste-management, biomass, composting, construction-material, mining, and related operators needing on-site or plant-based material processing worldwide.
strategy.why_we_win: They argue customers benefit from flexible deployment, tailored solutions, reliable high-quality machines, low downtime, efficient operating costs, and close service support.
strategy.resources: Long experience, skilled employees, modern production, quality materials, recognized suppliers, trained technicians, a global sales-and-parts network, telematics, and practical training capabilities.
strategy.direction: Advance technical development, broaden international activities, and keep adapting the portfolio to tougher processing requirements with resource-saving recycling solutions.
